debit.notes: 1800 1700 is the National Helpline, published as 'functioning all 24 hours 365 days'; +91 22 4444 2888 is the non-toll-free 24x7 customer care line for NR/overseas customers. Netbanking path: Value Added Service > Debit Card Services > Debit Card Hot-listing (login via the bank's Net Banking page). App path: IndSMART App > Cards menu. A second official email for hot-list requests is hoatmmonitoring@indianbank.bank.in; the page prints both addresses in [at]/[dot] anti-spam form. www.indianbank.in now 301-redirects to indianbank.bank.in; no SMS blocking channel is published for ATM/debit cards.

credit.sms: Please type the message 'BLOCKCC' and send the SMS to 56767 from your registered mobile to immediately block the card. You will get a confirmation message after blocking the card.
credit.notes: The bank's page (last modified May 30, 2026) lists exactly three hot-listing methods: SMS BLOCKCC to 56767, the '24 hours toll free Customer Care number' 1800 1700, and email handled 'during working days'. No netbanking or mobile-app blocking path is published for credit cards. +91 22 4444 2888 is the bank's non-toll-free 24x7 customer care line for NR/overseas customers (published on the quick-contact page), usable when the toll-free number is unreachable from abroad.

upi.notes: No UPI-only freeze is published. IndSMART app's published UPI feature list includes 'Block / Unblock UPI', 'De-register UPI', 'Manage VPA / PIN' and 'UPI Number Active/Inactive' (store links above; page last modified Sep 07, 2026). Emergency freeze-all: 'Customer can send a SMS BLOCK to 9289592895 from registered mobile number to block all digital channels' — blocking 'Debit card, Net Banking, Mobile Banking and UPI' — per the bank's Customer Complaints/Awareness (UEBT) page, which lists UEBT reporting via 'Making a call to our Toll Free no. 1800 1700', typing 'complaint' and sending SMS to 56677, Home Branch, mobile banking/net banking, and email cfrm@indianbank.bank.in; National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 also cited. WhatsApp Banking 8754424242 ('Just send Hi' to 8754424242) offers 'Block All Transactions' (Main Menu->Block Card/Trxn->Block All Txn) — 'Customer CIF will be blocked for any transaction' — plus Card Blocking and Lodging of Complaint. No netbanking UPI manage/disable path is published. The bank's USSD SOP publishes *99# (send/request money, balance, set/change UPI PIN) but its published menu lists no block/deregister option. NR/overseas 24x7 line: +91 22 4444 2888.
